name: receipts
description: Check a coding agent's claims against the evidence in its transcript and diff.
author: Sakshar Dhawan <sakshardhawanfzk@gmail.com>

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run smoke
scripts.eval: tsup --config tsup.eval.config.ts --silent && node --no-warnings .receipts/eval-build/run.js && prettier --write eval/results.md --log-level warn
scripts.label: tsup --config tsup.eval.config.ts --silent && node --no-warnings .receipts/eval-build/label.js
scripts.sample: npm run build && node dist/receipts.js check demo --no-llm --format html --out .receipts/sample --quiet && cp .receipts/sample/report.html docs/report.html
